title: Governance: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001
summary: EU AI Act sa izmjenama iz AI Omnibusa (uloge, nivoi rizika, zahtjevi i rokovi), NIST AI RMF i Generative AI profil, ISO/IEC 42001 te upravljanje AI-jem u organizaciji: politike, inventar i shadow AI, intake i procjena rizika, AI dobavljači i dokazi za audit.
title_en: Governance: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001
summary_en: The EU AI Act with the AI Omnibus amendments (roles, risk levels, requirements and deadlines), the NIST AI RMF and Generative AI Profile, ISO/IEC 42001, and AI governance in the organization: policies, inventory and shadow AI, intake and risk assessment, AI vendors and audit evidence.
